name: Out-year / MyCAP multi-year COLA inert (design drift)
expected: Per catalog, either out-year prices are wired into the procedure for Y2/Y3 billing, OR (agreed scope) out-year COLA stays FLAT: single-year per spec, with the broken Final_Year_COLA_Calculated_Price__c formula never feeding pricing. On a 3-year (36-month) Renewal line with COLA active and COLA_Outyear_Uplift_Percent__c populated, the line net must equal the single-year COLACalculatedPrice__c (Pre_COLA x (1+COLA%)) with NO out-year compounding; the billing total = single-year price x term, flat.
actual: CONFIRMED inert / single-year flat on live active V21 (9QBWC0000000oWH4AY). Real 3-year Renewal quote 0Q0WC000002lf6b0AA (TermDefined/Subscription, SubscriptionTerm=36, PricingTermCount=36, Active Defense BEC line 0QLWC0000037ljd4AA): COLA_Uplift_Percent__c=5, COLA_Outyear_Uplift_Percent__c=3 (out-year rate IS populated), Pre_COLA_Price__c=282000, COLACalculatedPrice__c=296100 (=282000x1.05, single-year). Stored NetUnitPrice=296100 and NetTotalPrice=10,659,600 (=296100 x 36, single-year price repeated flat across 36 months, NO compounding). Fresh Force-reprice through V21 (REST place isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[], LastModifiedDate 2026-06-30T02:01:14Z) kept NetUnitPrice=296100=COLACalculatedPrice__c; out-year 3% never compounded into Y2/Y3. Second 3yr line 0QLWC0000034WxF4AU (5250 Integrator, term36/PTC3, outyear=4) identical pattern: net=COLACalculatedPrice 6539.75, NetTotal=19619.26=6539.75x3, flat. V21 source has ZERO references to Final_Year_COLA / Outyear / COLA_Outyear / Pre_COLA_Price / compounding / EXP / multi-year / year2 / year3 / MyCAP (grep=0). The only 3 COLA steps (COLA Uplift Net on Renewal, COLA Uplift on Renewal x2) all assign from single-year COLACalculatedPrice__c -> NetUnitPrice/InputUnitPrice; none read out-year fields. Field Final_Year_COLA_Calculated_Price__c exists as a Formula(Currency) on QuoteLineItem but is NOT SOQL-queryable ('No such column'), so it could not feed pricing even if referenced; its formula branch-1 = COLACalculatedPrice x EXP(LN(1+outyear%/100) x (PricingTermCount-1)) uses PricingTermCount (months=36) as the YEAR exponent -> ^35 (=833,184 on this line) instead of the correct ^2 (=314,132): the documented unit-guard / wrong-base bug, dead-coded by design.
evidence: Clean control quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000002lf6b0AA/view (line 0QLWC0000037ljd4AA NetUnitPrice=296100=COLACalc, NetTotal pre-reprice=10,659,600=296100x36 flat, outyear=3 ignored). Second 3yr line https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000002iO2H0AU/view (0QLWC0000034WxF4AU net=6539.75=COLACalc, NetTotal=19619.26=x3 flat, outyear=4 ignored). Force-reprice resp Data/sc3354/j14_validation/reprice_resp_lf6b.json (isSuccess:true). V21 grep: 0 refs for Final_Year_COLA/Outyear/COLA_Outyear/Pre_COLA_Price/COLA_Uplift2/mycap/compound/EXP/multi-year/year2/year3 in Data/cola-v16-v20-reconcile/verify_v21/.../Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_V210.expressionSetVersion; COLA steps COLAUpliftNetonRenewal/COLAUpliftonRenewal at lines ~1838-1974 all source COLACalculatedPrice__c. Formula source force-app/main/default/objects/QuoteLineItem/fields/Final_Year_COLA_Calculated_Price__c.field-meta.xml (EXP/(PricingTermCount-1) exponent bug). FieldDefinition tooling: field IsCalculated=true but SOQL SELECT errors 'No such column'. Active version confirmed V21 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY (tooling ExpressionSetDefinitionVersion Status=Active).
proposedFix: No fix required for the agreed scope (single-year per spec). If multi-year out-year billing is later commissioned (owner-gated: Marc DeBrey/German + reconcile Leah Guenther's multi-year spreadsheet vs the single-year user story): (1) repair Final_Year_COLA_Calculated_Price__c to make it SOQL-queryable and replace the PricingTermCount-as-exponent with a true years count = PricingTermCount/12 (or SubscriptionTerm/12), guarded so single-year stays flat; (2) add a V21 committing step that wires the repaired out-year price into Y2/Y3 billing; (3) wire COLA_Outyear_Uplift_Percent__c as the distinct out-year rate. Until then, the tech-debt cleanup (remove the broken formula field + dead MyCAP price scaffolding) is declarative/UAT-safe (SC-3350 B3/B4). NOT applied (validation only).
regression: SC-3354 / SC-3346 RN-MULTIYEAR (closed 2026-06-14, confirmed out-of-scope; single-year per COLA SDD BR-002/6.3 + User Story Req#5)
notes: PASS = the catalog's agreed-scope outcome is realized: out-year/MyCAP multi-year COLA is INERT and the line bills single-year COLA flat across the term, exactly per spec. The Final_Year_COLA_Calculated_Price__c formula is genuinely broken (un-queryable + PricingTermCount(months)-as-year-exponent ^35 bug) but it has 0 procedure references and is un-SELECTable, so it never feeds pricing -> documented tech-debt, NOT a reportable PROCEDURE-DEFECT or money bug. This is design drift (spreadsheet model specifies Y2/Y3 compounding totals; build agreed single-year) deliberately resolved as single-year. Preflight: real UI-priced 3yr Renewal quote, CompletedWithPricing, USD, COLA fields all populated incl. out-year rate, reprices cleanly through V21. Explainability: V21 COLA branch gated ItemPricingSource=LastTransaction AND SalesTransactionActionType=Renew AND DerivedPricingAttribute=false AND COLA_Uplift_Percent__c IsNotNull, assigns single-year COLACalculatedPrice__c only. Headless reprice reset the TermDefined NetTotalPrice from 10,659,600 to per-unit 296100 (term-count proration multiply not re-applied headlessly = known harness/proration artifact, NOT a COLA defect); the pre-reprice stored NetTotal=296100x36 is the cleaner flat-billing evidence and the post-reprice per-unit=COLACalculatedPrice confirms the single-year branch. Distinct from J-04 (the separate single-year RENEWAL-MAINT $0/fossil net money bug, SC-3404). Read-only + Force-reprice only; no deploys/edits.
verdict_reason: On a live 3-year Renewal line with an out-year COLA rate populated, the net equals the single-year COLACalculatedPrice and bills flat (price x term) with zero out-year compounding, V21 has zero references to any out-year/Final_Year/MyCAP/compounding logic, and the broken Final_Year formula is un-queryable and un-wired -> out-year stays flat single-year exactly as the agreed scope specifies, so PASS.
